title: Reading complex-number form
description: interpret a complex quantity as the sum of its real and imaginary parts.

title: Applying exponent laws to exponentials
description: split and regroup expressions such as $e^{a+b}$ and $e^{at+bt}$.

title: Using Euler's formula
description: convert between $e^{j\theta}$ and $\cos \theta + j\sin \theta$.

title: Extracting real and imaginary parts
description: identify $\Re\{\cdot\}$ and $\Im\{\cdot\}$ from a complex expression.

title: Interpreting basic sinusoids
description: understand cosine and sine as oscillations and $\omega$ as angular frequency.

title: Interpreting real exponential growth and decay
description: tell from the sign of the exponent whether a signal grows, decays, or stays constant.

title: Defining signal periodicity
description: use $x(t+T)=x(t)$ as the condition for a repeating signal.

title: Defining a generalized exponential signal
description: interpret $x(t)=e^{st}$ with $s=\sigma+j\omega$ as the general exponential form.

title: Interpreting the roles of $\sigma$ and $\omega$
description: identify $\sigma$ as the growth or decay term and $\omega$ as the oscillation term.

title: Expanding a generalized exponential
description: rewrite $e^{(\sigma+j\omega)t}$ as $e^{\sigma t}e^{j\omega t}$ to separate growth from oscillation.

title: Converting a generalized exponential to cosine-sine form
description: use Euler's formula to rewrite the signal in cosine and sine components.

title: Extracting the real and imaginary components
description: identify the cosine term as the real part and the sine term as the imaginary part.

title: Analyzing the pure exponential case
description: determine whether the signal is constant, growing, or decaying when $\omega=0$.

title: Analyzing the pure oscillatory case
description: interpret $e^{j\omega t}$ as a pure complex sinusoid when $\sigma=0$.

title: Relating $\omega$ to oscillation speed
description: determine how changing $|\omega|$ changes the rate of oscillation.

title: Analyzing the mixed exponential case
description: interpret $\sigma \neq 0,\ \omega \neq 0$ as simultaneous oscillation with exponential growth or decay.

title: Identifying damped and growing sinusoids
description: use the sign of $\sigma$ to determine whether the oscillation decays or increases in amplitude.

title: Interpreting exponential envelopes
description: understand $\pm e^{\sigma t}$ as amplitude bounds that contain the oscillation.

title: Connecting generalized exponentials to physical systems
description: recognize generalized exponentials as models for damped oscillatory behavior in physical systems.

title: Applying the periodicity test to $e^{j\omega t}$
description: derive the condition under which a pure complex exponential repeats over time.

title: Computing the fundamental period of a complex exponential
description: find $T_0=\frac{2\pi}{\omega}$ for the signal's smallest positive repeat time.

title: Interpreting general repetition times
description: recognize that any integer multiple of $T_0$ is also a valid repeat time.

title: Using the rotating-phasor picture
description: explain periodicity geometrically by tracking the phasor's motion around the unit circle.
